'''Skeleton shielders''' are enemies encountered in the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath]] encounter.

When summoned by Zemouregal, the shielder will immediately apply a protective barrier around Vorkath, reducing damage dealt to it by 25% for each shielder alive. 

==Life points==
The shielder's [[life points]] scale accordingly to the amount of players in the instance when they were summoned.
